d:
A political controversy has erupted surrounding Alya Khatija, who questioned Rahul Gandhi about the participation of youth in politics during an event at Columbia University in the US. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju shared a video of the interaction, claiming that Alya has ties to a political family associated with the Congress party. The BJP has alleged that the entire episode—involving a young person posing a question to Rahul Gandhi—was staged.
